encode_hilbert_locations: encode array of hypercube locations into Hilbert integers using num_dims and num_bits
decode_hilbert_integers: decode Hilbert integers back into hypercube location coordinates with num_dims and num_bits
convert_binary_to_gray: convert binary values into Gray codes using the X XOR (X >> 1) trick
convert_gray_to_binary: convert Gray codes back into binary values with iterative shift and xor
right_shift_binary_array: right shift an array of binary values by k bits along a specified axis
